The Indian textile market is estimated to reach USD 180 billion in FY 2025-26. - Policy Support: PLI Scheme 2.0 for MMF and technical textiles, operationalization of PM MITRA Parks. - Value Chain Strength: India retains a complete fiber-to-garment ecosystem with leadership in cotton, growing strength in MMF and technical textiles.
FUTURE OUTLOOK The global textile market is projected to reach USD 1.8-2.0 trillion by 2030, growing at 4-5% CAGR.
